He raised his lantern and answered, his hands suddenly steady again.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一本尚未合拢的书。路灯把淡黄的光铺在空街上，清洁车缓缓驶过，留下湿润的轨迹。早点铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽贴着玻璃升腾。桥下的河水无声流动，偶尔映出出租车的红尾灯。有人刚刚下班，有人已经出门；窗帘后沉睡的梦，还不知道天边正悄悄变蓝。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box inside, and repeating until you reach a toy.\n- Every recursive process needs a stopping rule, like stopping when there are no more boxes."}
